configurations.description: Enables the capture of experimental log attributes, including thread name and thread ID.
configurations.name: otel.instrumentation.logback-appender.experimental-log-attributes

configurations.description: Enables the capture of log message arguments as separate attributes.

configurations.description: Enables the capture of code location attributes, including file path, class name, method name, and line number.

configurations.description: Deprecated setting that enables the capture of all attributes from Logback key value pairs. It is ignored when otel.instrumentation.logback-appender.experimental.key-value-pair-attributes.included or otel.instrumentation.logback-appender.experimental.key-value-pair-attributes.excluded is configured, and it may be removed in the next minor release. Use otel.instrumentation.logback-appender.experimental.key-value-pair-attributes.included instead.
configurations.name: otel.instrumentation.logback-appender.experimental.capture-key-value-pair-attributes

configurations.description: Deprecated setting that enables the capture of all attributes from the Logback logger context. It is ignored when otel.instrumentation.logback-appender.experimental.logger-context-attributes.included or otel.instrumentation.logback-appender.experimental.logger-context-attributes.excluded is configured, and it may be removed in the next minor release. Use otel.instrumentation.logback-appender.experimental.logger-context-attributes.included instead.
configurations.name: otel.instrumentation.logback-appender.experimental.capture-logger-context-attributes

configurations.description: Deprecated setting that enables the capture of all attributes from Logstash markers, supported are those added to logs via Markers.append(), Markers.appendEntries(), Markers.appendArray() and Markers.appendRaw() methods. It is ignored when otel.instrumentation.logback-appender.experimental.logstash-marker-attributes.included or otel.instrumentation.logback-appender.experimental.logstash-marker-attributes.excluded is configured, and it may be removed in the next minor release. Use otel.instrumentation.logback-appender.experimental.logstash-marker-attributes.included instead.
configurations.name: otel.instrumentation.logback-appender.experimental.capture-logstash-marker-attributes

configurations.description: Deprecated setting that enables the capture of all attributes from Logstash structured arguments (e.g., StructuredArguments.v() and StructuredArguments.keyValue()). It is ignored when otel.instrumentation.logback-appender.experimental.logstash-structured-argument-attributes.included or otel.instrumentation.logback-appender.experimental.logstash-structured-argument-attributes.excluded is configured, and it may be removed in the next minor release. Use otel.instrumentation.logback-appender.experimental.logstash-structured-argument-attributes.included instead.
configurations.name: otel.instrumentation.logback-appender.experimental.capture-logstash-structured-arguments

configurations.description: Enables the capture of the Logback marker attribute.
configurations.name: otel.instrumentation.logback-appender.experimental.capture-marker-attribute

configurations.description: Deprecated comma-separated list of MDC keys to capture as log attributes. Keys are matched literally, including "*" and "?", except that the single value "*" captures all MDC attributes. It is ignored when otel.instrumentation.logback-appender.experimental.mdc-attributes.included or otel.instrumentation.logback-appender.experimental.mdc-attributes.excluded is configured, and it may be removed in the next minor release. Use otel.instrumentation.logback-appender.experimental.mdc-attributes.included instead.
configurations.name: otel.instrumentation.logback-appender.experimental.capture-mdc-attributes

configurations.description: Enables the capture of the log message template before parameter substitution.
configurations.name: otel.instrumentation.logback-appender.experimental.capture-template

configurations.description: Comma-separated list of case-sensitive glob patterns for Logback key value pair keys not to capture as log attributes. "*" matches any number of characters and "?" matches one character. Excluded patterns take precedence over included patterns. No key value pair attributes are captured unless an included pattern, an excluded pattern, or the deprecated otel.instrumentation.logback-appender.experimental.capture-key-value-pair-attributes setting is configured; configuring only excluded patterns captures all key value pair attributes that do not match them. Captured key value pair attributes may contain sensitive information.
configurations.name: otel.instrumentation.logback-appender.experimental.key-value-pair-attributes.excluded

configurations.description: Comma-separated list of case-sensitive glob patterns for Logback key value pair keys to capture as log attributes. "*" matches any number of characters and "?" matches one character, so "*" captures all key value pair attributes. Excluded patterns take precedence over included patterns. No key value pair attributes are captured unless an included pattern, an excluded pattern, or the deprecated otel.instrumentation.logback-appender.experimental.capture-key-value-pair-attributes setting is configured; configuring only excluded patterns captures all key value pair attributes that do not match them. Captured key value pair attributes may contain sensitive information.
